author: XamOps Team
description: Seed manifest for 26 production-ready Bash automation scripts. The bulk-import task (4.6) reads each entry, loads the referenced .sh file from the classpath at codeBaseDir/codeFile, and persists a DevOpsScript plus its ScriptParameter rows. Customizable values use the {{PARAMETER_NAME}} placeholder syntax.

scripts.name: Install Docker Engine
scripts.description: Installs Docker Engine, CLI, containerd, and the Compose plugin on Debian/Ubuntu hosts with the official repository and a pinnable version.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root (sudo) access and outbound internet connectivity.

parameters.name: DOCKER_VERSION
parameters.label: Docker Version
parameters.description: Docker Engine version to pin, or 'latest'.

parameters.name: COMPOSE_VERSION
parameters.label: Compose Plugin Version
parameters.description: Docker Compose plugin version expected after install.

scripts.name: Configure UFW Firewall
scripts.description: Establishes a deny-by-default UFW firewall baseline, rate-limits SSH, and opens a customizable list of service ports.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root access. Confirm the SSH port before enabling to avoid lockout.

parameters.name: SSH_PORT
parameters.label: SSH Port
parameters.description: TCP port for SSH access (will be rate-limited).

parameters.name: ALLOWED_PORTS
parameters.label: Additional Allowed Ports
parameters.description: Space-separated extra ports to open, e.g. '80/tcp 443/tcp'.

scripts.name: SSH Hardening
scripts.description: Hardens the SSH daemon: disables root login and password auth, enforces key-based auth, sets a custom port, and restricts access to named users with config validation and rollback.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and a working SSH key for the allowed users. Keep an active session open while testing.

parameters.name: SSH_PORT
parameters.label: SSH Port
parameters.description: Port the SSH daemon should listen on.

parameters.name: ALLOWED_USERS
parameters.label: Allowed Users
parameters.description: Space-separated list of users permitted to log in via SSH.

scripts.name: Collect System Metrics
scripts.description: Samples CPU, memory, disk, and load averages and appends them as CSV rows for ingestion by monitoring tooling. Supports one-shot or interval modes.
scripts.prerequisites: Linux host with top, free, and df available.

parameters.name: METRICS_OUTPUT
parameters.label: Metrics Output File
parameters.description: Path to the CSV file metrics are appended to.

parameters.name: INTERVAL_SECONDS
parameters.label: Sampling Interval (s)
parameters.description: Seconds between samples; 0 runs once and exits.

scripts.name: Setup Log Rotation
scripts.description: Creates a logrotate configuration for an application log path with daily rotation, compression, and a configurable retention period, validated with a dry run.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and logrotate installed.

parameters.name: LOG_PATH
parameters.label: Log Path Glob
parameters.description: Glob of log files to rotate, e.g. /var/log/myapp/*.log.

parameters.name: RETENTION_DAYS
parameters.label: Retention (days)
parameters.description: Number of rotated copies to keep.

scripts.name: Disk Space Alert
scripts.description: Checks all mounted filesystems and emails an alert for any that exceed a usage threshold. Designed to run from cron.
scripts.prerequisites: A configured MTA / 'mail' command for email delivery.

parameters.name: THRESHOLD_PERCENT
parameters.label: Usage Threshold (%)
parameters.description: Disk usage percentage that triggers an alert.

parameters.name: ALERT_EMAIL
parameters.label: Alert Email
parameters.description: Recipient email address for alerts.

scripts.name: Database Backup to S3
scripts.description: Dumps a PostgreSQL database, gzip-compresses it, and uploads it to S3 under a timestamped key, cleaning up the local dump afterward.
scripts.prerequisites: pg_dump, AWS CLI configured with S3 write access, and DB credentials supplied via PGPASSWORD or ~/.pgpass.

parameters.name: DB_NAME
parameters.label: Database Name
parameters.description: Name of the database to back up.

parameters.name: DB_HOST
parameters.label: Database Host
parameters.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL server.

parameters.name: BACKUP_BUCKET
parameters.label: S3 Backup Bucket
parameters.description: Target S3 bucket name for the backup.

scripts.name: Filesystem Backup with rsync
scripts.description: Performs an incremental filesystem backup with rsync to a local or remote destination, preserving permissions and pruning removed files.
scripts.prerequisites: rsync installed; SSH key access to the remote host if backing up offsite.

parameters.name: SOURCE_PATH
parameters.label: Source Path
parameters.description: Directory to back up.

parameters.name: DEST_PATH
parameters.label: Destination Path
parameters.description: Backup destination directory.

parameters.name: REMOTE_HOST
parameters.label: Remote Host
parameters.description: Optional user@host for offsite backup; leave blank for local.

scripts.name: Automated Backup Scheduling
scripts.description: Idempotently installs or updates a cron entry that runs a backup script on a schedule and logs output to a dedicated file.
scripts.prerequisites: An executable backup script and crontab available for the running user.

parameters.name: BACKUP_SCRIPT
parameters.label: Backup Script Path
parameters.description: Absolute path to the backup script to schedule.

parameters.name: CRON_SCHEDULE
parameters.label: Cron Schedule
parameters.description: Five-field cron expression, e.g. '0 2 * * *'.

scripts.name: Blue-Green Deployment Helper
scripts.description: Deploys a containerized app using blue-green strategy: starts a green container, health-checks it, switches over on success, and rolls back on failure.
scripts.prerequisites: Docker installed; an app image exposing a health endpoint; a load balancer to switch ports.

parameters.name: APP_NAME
parameters.label: App Image
parameters.description: Image reference to deploy, e.g. myorg/web:1.4.2.

parameters.name: HEALTH_URL
parameters.label: Health URL Template
parameters.description: Health endpoint; use %PORT% as a placeholder for the candidate port.

parameters.name: BLUE_PORT
parameters.label: Blue (Live) Port
parameters.description: Port currently serving live traffic.

parameters.name: GREEN_PORT
parameters.label: Green (New) Port
parameters.description: Port for the new release.

scripts.name: Rolling Restart
scripts.description: Restarts a systemd-managed service across multiple logical instances one at a time, waiting for each to become active to minimize downtime.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and systemd-managed service units.

parameters.name: SERVICE_NAME
parameters.label: Service Name
parameters.description: Base systemd unit name (use 'name@' for templated units).

parameters.name: INSTANCES
parameters.label: Instance IDs
parameters.description: Space-separated instance identifiers, or blank for a single unit.

scripts.name: Health Check Automation
scripts.description: Polls an HTTP health endpoint with retries and exponential backoff, exiting zero only when healthy. Suitable for CI gates and cron checks.
scripts.prerequisites: curl available on the host.

parameters.name: HEALTH_URL
parameters.label: Health URL
parameters.description: Full health endpoint URL to probe.

parameters.name: MAX_RETRIES
parameters.label: Max Retries
parameters.description: Maximum number of attempts before failing.

scripts.name: SSL Certificate Renewal (Let's Encrypt)
scripts.description: Renews Let's Encrypt certificates via certbot and reloads nginx only when a certificate is actually renewed. Safe to run from cron.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access, certbot with the nginx plugin, and DNS pointing at this host.

parameters.name: DOMAIN_NAME
parameters.label: Domain Name
parameters.description: Primary domain for the certificate.

parameters.name: CERT_EMAIL
parameters.label: Contact Email
parameters.description: Email for expiry notices and ACME registration.

scripts.name: Security Audit
scripts.description: Runs a read-only security audit covering users, root-equivalent accounts, sudoers, listening ports, world-writable files, failed logins, and pending security updates, writing a report.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access for a complete audit.

parameters.name: REPORT_PATH
parameters.label: Report Path
parameters.description: File to write the audit report to.

scripts.name: User Access Management
scripts.description: Creates a system user, installs an SSH public key, and optionally grants passwordless sudo with sudoers validation. Idempotent and safe to re-run.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and the user's SSH public key.

parameters.name: USERNAME
parameters.label: Username
parameters.description: Linux username to create or manage.

parameters.name: SSH_PUBLIC_KEY
parameters.label: SSH Public Key
parameters.description: The user's SSH public key (ssh-ed25519 / ssh-rsa ...).

parameters.name: SUDO_ACCESS
parameters.label: Grant Sudo
parameters.description: Whether to grant passwordless sudo.

scripts.name: System Update & Patching
scripts.description: Applies OS package updates non-interactively on Debian/Ubuntu, cleans up unused packages, and optionally reboots when required.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root access.

parameters.name: REBOOT_IF_REQUIRED
parameters.label: Reboot If Required
parameters.description: Reboot automatically when updates require it.

scripts.name: Configure Swap File
scripts.description: Creates and enables a persistent swap file of a given size and tunes swappiness for server workloads. Idempotent if swap already exists.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and sufficient free disk space.

parameters.name: SWAP_SIZE_GB
parameters.label: Swap Size (GB)
parameters.description: Desired swap file size in gigabytes.

scripts.name: Install & Configure fail2ban
scripts.description: Installs fail2ban and configures an SSH jail with customizable ban time and retry threshold via a local override that survives package updates.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root access and systemd.

parameters.name: BANTIME
parameters.label: Ban Time (s)
parameters.description: How long an offending IP is banned, in seconds.

parameters.name: MAXRETRY
parameters.label: Max Retries
parameters.description: Failed attempts allowed before a ban.

scripts.name: Nginx Reverse Proxy Setup
scripts.description: Installs nginx if needed and configures a reverse-proxy virtual host that forwards a domain to an upstream application server with WebSocket support.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and an upstream application listening on the target host/port.

parameters.name: DOMAIN_NAME
parameters.label: Domain Name
parameters.description: Public server name for the virtual host.

parameters.name: UPSTREAM_HOST
parameters.label: Upstream Host
parameters.description: Host or IP to proxy requests to.

parameters.name: UPSTREAM_PORT
parameters.label: Upstream Port
parameters.description: Port the upstream application listens on.

scripts.name: PostgreSQL Backup & Restore
scripts.description: Backs up or restores a PostgreSQL database using the custom dump format to a local directory, with automatic rotation of old backups.
scripts.prerequisites: pg_dump and pg_restore available; database credentials configured.

parameters.name: DB_NAME
parameters.label: Database Name
parameters.description: Database to back up or restore.

parameters.name: DB_USER
parameters.label: Database User
parameters.description: PostgreSQL user with sufficient privileges.

parameters.name: BACKUP_DIR
parameters.label: Backup Directory
parameters.description: Local directory for dump files.

scripts.name: Service Watchdog
scripts.description: Monitors a systemd service and automatically restarts it if it stops. Runs once (cron) or continuously at an interval.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and a systemd-managed service to monitor.

parameters.name: SERVICE_NAME
parameters.label: Service Name
parameters.description: systemd unit to monitor.

parameters.name: CHECK_INTERVAL
parameters.label: Check Interval (s)
parameters.description: Seconds between checks in loop mode; 0 checks once.

scripts.name: CPU & Memory Alert
scripts.description: Checks current CPU and memory utilization and posts a JSON alert to a webhook (Slack/Teams/Discord) when thresholds are breached.
scripts.prerequisites: curl available and an incoming webhook URL.

parameters.name: CPU_THRESHOLD
parameters.label: CPU Threshold (%)
parameters.description: CPU usage percent that triggers an alert.

parameters.name: MEM_THRESHOLD
parameters.label: Memory Threshold (%)
parameters.description: Memory usage percent that triggers an alert.

parameters.name: WEBHOOK_URL
parameters.label: Webhook URL
parameters.description: URL to POST the JSON alert payload to.

scripts.name: Cleanup Old Logs
scripts.description: Deletes log files older than a retention window within a directory tree, guarding against protected paths and reporting reclaimed space.
scripts.prerequisites: Read/write access to the target log directory.

parameters.name: LOG_PATH
parameters.label: Log Directory
parameters.description: Directory to scan and clean.

parameters.name: RETENTION_DAYS
parameters.label: Retention (days)
parameters.description: Delete files older than this many days.

scripts.name: Port Connectivity Check
scripts.description: Checks TCP connectivity from this host to a target across a set of ports, using nc or a pure-bash /dev/tcp fallback. Exits non-zero on any failure.
scripts.prerequisites: Network access to the target host.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOST
parameters.label: Target Host
parameters.description: Hostname or IP to test connectivity to.

parameters.name: PORTS
parameters.label: Ports
parameters.description: Space-separated TCP ports to check.

scripts.name: NTP Time Synchronization
scripts.description: Configures time synchronization with systemd-timesyncd using a custom NTP server and verifies the clock is synchronized.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and a systemd-based host.

parameters.name: NTP_SERVER
parameters.label: NTP Server
parameters.description: NTP server to synchronize against.

scripts.name: Docker Container Deployment
scripts.description: Pulls an image and (re)deploys a single container with a restart policy and port mapping, replacing any existing container of the same name and verifying it started.
scripts.prerequisites: Docker installed and access to the image registry.

parameters.name: IMAGE
parameters.label: Image
parameters.description: Image reference to deploy, e.g. nginx:1.25.

parameters.name: CONTAINER_NAME
parameters.label: Container Name
parameters.description: Name for the running container.

parameters.name: HOST_PORT
parameters.label: Host Port
parameters.description: Host port to publish.

parameters.name: CONTAINER_PORT
parameters.label: Container Port
parameters.description: Container port to map to.
